 First round of November Social Security payments goes out in 10 days
 By Emily Danner 
 Published
 October 31, 2026 6:00am ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 The first round of November Social Security payments for retirees, now capped at $5,181, will be issued in 10 days.
 When will payments arrive?
 Retirees born on or before the 10th of a month will receive this payment on Tuesday, Nov. 10 .
